high_level_description: This image is a tweet from Maye Musk, the mother of Elon Musk, celebrating his 53rd birthday. The tweet reads: "Happy Birthday @elonmusk Thank you for 53 years of joy and excitement. Hoping you smile today as much as you did on your 4th birthday, after seeing the cake your Aunt Lynne made for you 🎂🎉🎁 Proud of you. 😊😊😊" The tweet includes a photograph of a young child, presumably Elon Musk at age four, standing outdoors in front of a large, elaborately decorated birthday cake.
